# 🧰 Documentation templates

Use these templates to make future contributions consistent. Templates are starting points, not evidence that a feature or test already exists.

- [Architecture Decision Record](architecture-decision-record.md)
- [Artwork rights and attribution record](artwork-rights-record.md)
- [Browser test report](browser-test-report.md)
- [Feature proposal](feature-proposal.md)

Copy a template into the appropriate documentation location, fill in verified information, and remove instructional placeholders before publishing.
